messages:
Jordan: Heads-up — leadership just asked for a compressed launch band. We need to decide what absolutely must stay in the MVP vs what can shift to v1. Launch window moved up ~2w. Priya, any blocker on the enterprise pilot ask?
Priya: The ACME pilot asked for tenant-level routing and SAML. Both are high effort. If we cut one, SAML is stickier for compliance; tenant routing is more product-y.
Amy: From infra/eng side — tenant routing adds ~3w of work (routing + e2e tests + perf tuning). SAML is mostly auth integration work (~1.5w) but has compliance signoff.
Matt: From design/ux — tenant routing has no new screens but adds complexity for admin flows. SAML needs a tiny admin screen and an installer doc.
Rob: If we cut tenant routing to v1, we lose per-tenant routing for some pilot scenarios. Is there a lightweight workaround (manual mapping) we can promise?
Priya: Yes — we could ship an early manual-mapping workflow: admin uploads CSV to map tenant->model. Not ideal, but pilot-able. Priya: That would keep the pilot alive and buy engineering time.
Jordan: OK — proposal: cut tenant routing from MVP, keep SAML but scope it to a single identity provider (ACME corp). Add a rollback plan. Agree? :thinking:
Amy: +1 on cut. Also recommend toggling cache/batch defaults to conservative values to reduce infra risk.
SRE Bot: Deploy bot: staging rollout queued for release/1768. Note: average p50 latency with conservative batching + KV cache off = 110ms.
Rob: Add to launch criteria doc: must-have = single-IDP SAML, manual tenant mapping workflow, perf under 150ms p50, error budget <1% 24h.
Matt: I'll update the admin UX and the install doc; will attach mock in #design later.
Jordan: I'll update the milestone tracker and notify sales. Quick action items:
```text
- Priya: confirm ACME SLA acceptance
- Amy: remove tenant routing from runtime plan, add manual import endpoint
- Matt: admin UX + CSV import flows
- Rob: update launch criteria & comms
- Jordan: notify leadership and update tracker
```
Jordan: If nobody objects by EOD, we'll lock the MVP cut and rebaseline the timeline. :thumbsup:
